content: Gemini REST API (bespoke, not OpenAI-compatible). generateContent: POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent. streamGenerateContent: same path with ':streamGenerateContent?alt=sse' -> emits SSE 'data: ' framed GenerateContentResponse chunks. Auth: x-goog-api-key header (GEMINI_API_KEY). Request: contents[] with role user|model and parts[] ({text} etc.), systemInstruction{parts[]}, generationConfig{temperature,maxOutputTokens,topP,topK,stopSequences,candidateCount}. Response: candidates[].content.parts[].text, finishReason (STOP|MAX_TOKENS|SAFETY|OTHER|RECITATION), usageMetadata{promptTokenCount,candidatesTokenCount,totalTokenCount}. Error shape: {error:{code,message,status}}. Model IDs: gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-3.1-pro-preview.
